name: Scroll Text Reveal
description: A GSAP ScrollTrigger text reveal for React: in a pinned section, letters brighten one by one as you scroll, each flashing in an accent colour and settling to the text colour over a second, so a soft coloured wake trails the reading point; several paragraphs take turns, each rising in line by line. SplitText, re-splits on resize.

props.name: paragraphs
props.description: The paragraphs, read one after another in the same place.

props.name: accent
props.description: The colour each letter flashes as it lights.

props.name: dim
props.description: Opacity of letters not yet read.

props.name: settle
props.description: Seconds a letter takes to settle from the accent to the ink (longer = longer wake).

props.name: length
props.description: Section height in screens: more is slower reading.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section (the font, for one).
